title: OpenMercs - MechWarrior 2: Mercenaries, Reimagined
author: Alopexy
selftext:
Reposting this here since the r/mechwarrior moderators can't seem to make up their minds about what constitutes a valid project. SOO.. This is OpenMercs, an independent, non-commercial reimplementation of MechWarrior 2: Mercenaries Titanium for modern machines.

I’ve put together about six minutes of gameplay across three environments, showing the updated environments, cockpit, textures and weather effects blending into the classic gameplay of Mech2: Mercs.

NetMech multiplayer and campaign co-op are planned and i'm hoping to have both up and running before public release.

It’s still in development and as such, there’s no public download or release date just yet, and the repository is currently private, though I'll be open-sourcing everything alongside the initial release very soon. The project uses game data from your own legitimate copy of Mercenaries Titanium. I'll see if I can also add support for other release versions of Mercenaries as well.

I’ve also launched a website with screenshots, development status and community links:

* [**OpenMercs website**](https://openmercs.com)
* [**Join the OpenMercs Discord**](https://discord.gg/xxMYCrDjEz)

I’d love to hear what you think of the footage, particularly the cockpit presentation and atmosphere.

Thanks for checking out the project. It's been a lot of fun to work on and I can't wait to share it with everyone soon. Cheers!
